_comment: Both classes and the Check unit are looked up, never written: the Verification Usage class and its Check unit were built by hand on 2026-10-06 and kept; the Currency class is pre-seeded. The EUR unit (hand-made 2026-10-06, Type Custom because the UI offers nothing else) IS owned, because it needs Scale 2: the quote line editor refuses a decimal quantity unless the product's UnitOfMeasure has a Scale (found 2026-10-07 on the 700,181.60 commitment line).
